report.explanation: All current read-only telemetry is healthy: gateway and order traces OK at 70ms, p95 80ms, error rate 0.0012, zero db pool waiters and dependency timeouts, INFO 200 logs. The deployment record (order 3.2.0, 490 min old) cannot establish latency causation. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause, so no bounded candidate can be asserted; hand off for the missing degradation evidence.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing actual checkout degradation (elevated error rate or p95 latency) in the alert window; current traces/metrics/logs are healthy.
Evidence of db pool waiters or dependency timeouts on order/postgresql path to assess db-pool-exhaustion.
Redis latency/timeout telemetry for inventory->redis to assess redis-timeout.
Downstream latency breakdown for order->inventory/payment to assess downstream-latency.
Longer memory-retention time series per service to assess memory-leak.
Configuration diff or error logs tied to order version 3.2.0 to assess bad-configuration.
